title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-09-20
source: Source Info: Master Soundboard Reels (borrowed by Peter Kafer) > Will Boswell's reel @ 7 1/2 ips; Transfer Info: Reel (Technics RS1506) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1bit/5.6 MHz) > dBpoweramp 24/96 > Adobe Audition 3.0 > TLH flac2496

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of the 9/20/70 show featuring epic performances of Cumberland Blues, New Speedway Boogie and a moving To Lay Me Down.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about the superb playing on this 1970 performance – highlighting the soaring “Cumberland Blues,” the driving “New Speedway Boogie,” and Jerry’s solemn treatment of “To Lay Me Down.” The FLAC soundboard source is praised as clean and vivid, making the show a must‑listen for Deadheads.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviews are strongly positive (average 4.6 stars) and emphasize both outstanding musical moments and a clean soundboard recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No specific complaints; reviewers describe the version as stunning, implying clear, well‑balanced FLAC soundboard audio.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows naturally with acoustic/electric dynamics typical of 1970, building from the gentle “To Lay Me Down” into high‑energy numbers like “Cumberland Blues” and “New Speedway Boogie.”

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as delivering a solemn, longing guitar treatment on “To Lay Me Down,” with some reviewers noting unexpected piano work.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir’s rhythm guitar and vocal bits are noted in passing, adding texture to the performance.
band_member_comments.Keys: Tom Constanten (TC) provides soft, mournful piano that complements Pigpen’s organ, creating a subtle interplay.
